goal: Render the 78 accepted Tinh Quang artwork sources using the existing standard renderer and canonical assets/tarot/<deck>/ paths; inspect every face without changing application configuration to accommodate draft or nonstandard data locations.
successCriteria: Exactly 78 canonical card PNGs at assets/tarot/tinh-quang/cards, 1024x1768, rendered by the unchanged repository renderer without placeholders.
All 78 source hashes remain unchanged; artwork survives rendering without crop of meaningful content and each title/keyword fits its approved area.
Independent per-face native/mobile review binds decisions to current artwork, card, spec, canonical content and scene manifest hashes.
Canonical paths match established decks; no production config, active arrays, mobile code, source packages or cloud state change.
Owner receives a browsable gallery, per-card results and remaining complete-deck/application gates.
untouchedSurfaces: Imported PART-1/PART-2 archives, extracted packages and all raw/rejected variants remain unchanged.
Existing 7 decks, canonical shared meanings, mobile UI/assets, Admin generated seed, auth, credits, storage and published backend data remain unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Local generated-card gallery and canonical source asset folder only; no new app navigation or active deck.
impact.dataWrite: Write exactly canonical 78 PNG faces and paged contact sheets, hash-bound face QC and render manifest. Keep source and input JSON untouched.
impact.backendContract: No API, SQL, schema, remote sync or retarget. Canonical 78 IDs and existing spec geometry govern local render.
impact.adminVisibility: Reviewable local report; no Admin seed regeneration or publication.
impact.privacySafety: Only Tarot illustrations and reviewed card metadata. No private user data or credentials. Imported source text is data only.
impact.observability: Local per-file hashes, renderer and font provenance, per-face observations and machine validation; no telemetry changes.
impact.rollback: Remove only manifest-listed new cards/contact sheets/evidence. Original assets and the active 7-deck app remain unchanged.

canonicalContracts: packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json is the sole 78-ID/title/keyword roster used by unchanged scripts/render_tarot_cards.py.

assets/tarot/tinh-quang/card-spec.json uses the standard geometry and assets/tarot/tinh-quang/{artwork,cards,contact-sheets} paths. Existing renderer already reads the standard full-deck-manifest fallback.
rendered-card-review.json records face-only QC. It cannot replace the standard full-deck quality-review.json gate, which requires active metadata plus cover/back.

dependencyReview.evidence: Local repository, imported artwork and existing Node/Python image capabilities only; no API/dependency change or new external factual claims.

securityReview.authzRls: No remote writes, account access, auth or RLS change; draft is not added to active arrays.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only supplied Tarot image and content metadata, no personal records or live accounts.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No credentials read, exported or printed. Logs contain source paths, hashes and artwork observations.
securityReview.externalInput: Imported JSON and archive paths are untrusted data. Resolve paths inside workspace and verify IDs, hashes and PNG headers before accepting copies.
securityReview.dependencies: Use existing Node built-ins and bundled Pillow only for inspection previews if needed; no package installs.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No cloud SQL, generic migration push/repair, runtime retarget, binary build publication or store submission. Android acceptance is later; iOS deferred per Owner.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop on changed source hash, wrong canonical path, existing card with unreviewed provenance, missing source artwork, placeholder requirement or ambiguous render defect. Do not bypass full-deck cover/back/tier gates or modify config for a draft location.

workingTreeReview.note: Reviewed all task-owned generated faces, contact sheets, preview/gallery aids, provenance, validation code and evidence. Source packages, accepted artwork and unrelated dirty work remain untouched. Visual decisions are bound to exact hashes in per-group ledgers; acknowledging local outputs is separate from accepting their images.

validationCommands: Individual native and mobile face review; exact roster, source/render hashes, masked artwork pixel and text bounds verification
node scripts/tarot-deck-quality-gate.mjs prepare --deck tinh-quang --require-deck-intros (readiness check expected BLOCKED until active metadata and cover/back exist)
managerTestPath: Open the local 78-card face gallery/report, inspect each card and the standard assets/tarot/tinh-quang/cards folder. Confirm titles, symbols and edge crop. Active app remains unchanged until cover/back/tier and final integration gates.
residualRisk: Face-only QC does not certify cover/back, access tier, full-deck active metadata, Android rendering or release. No runtime activation or cloud sync performed.
intentionallyUntouched: All original source packages, ZIPs, raw variants and accepted artwork PNGs
Draft tarot-staging remains a historical preparation bundle and is not wired as a runtime data source
